title: Sampling Protocol for Feces in Preterm Infants
author: Yuan Zhenya
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.tn4emgw
materials: The bacterial genomic DNA from samples was extracted by E.Z.N.A.® Soil DNA Kit (Omega Bio-tek, Norcross, GA, U.S.) according to the manufacturer’s protocols. The final DNA concentration and purification were determined by NanoDrop 2000 UV-vis spectrophotometer (Thermo Scientific, Wilmington, USA), and DNA quality was checked by 1% agarose gel electrophoresis.

The bacterial primer set of forward primer 338F (5’-ACTCCTACGGGAGGCAGCAG-3’) and reverse primer 806R (5’-GGACTACHVGGGTWTCTAAT-3’) were used to amplify the DNA fragment of the 16S rRNA genes. TransStart Fastpfu DNA Polymerase and thermocycler PCR system (GeneAmp 9700, ABI, USA) were available for PCR. PCR reactions were performed in triplicate 20 μL mixture containing 4 μL of 5 × FastPfu Buffer, 2 μL of 2.5 mM dNTPs, 0.8 μL of each primer (5 μM), 0.4 μL of FastPfu Polymerase and 10 ng of template DNA. Amplification conditions were as follows: An initial denaturation step of 95℃ for 3 min, followed by 27 cycles of the denaturation at 95℃ for 30 s, annealing at 55℃ for 30 s, elongating at 72℃ for 45 s with a final extension step at 72℃ for 5 min, halted at 10℃. The resulted PCR products were extracted from a 2% agarose gel and further purified using the AxyPrep DNA Gel Extraction Kit (Axygen Biosciences, Union City, CA, USA) and quantified using QuantiFluor™-ST Real-time PCR System (Promega, USA) according to the manufacturer’s protocol before sequencing.

steps.title: Collect and Store Fecal Samples
steps.instruction: Collect fecal samples from the diapers of preterm infants and store them for DNA extraction.

substeps.instruction: Use disposable sterile swabs to collect samples.

steps.title: Perform 16S rRNA Gene Sequencing
steps.instruction: Conduct 16S rRNA gene sequencing using the Illumina Miseq 300 Platform (Illumina, San Diego, USA) following standard protocols by Majorbio Bio-pharm Technology Co., Ltd., Shanghai, China.

steps.title: Quality-Filter and Merge Raw Fastq Files
steps.instruction: Process raw fastq files using Trimmomatic for quality filtering and FLASH for merging based on specific quality and overlap criteria.

substeps.instruction: Truncate reads at any site with an average quality score <20 over a 50bp sliding window using Trimmomatic.
Merge sequences with an overlap longer than 10bp and no more than 2bp mismatch using FLASH.
Separate sample sequences by barcodes (exact match) and Primers (allowing 2 nucleotide mismatching).

steps.title: Cluster OTUs and Analyze Taxonomy
steps.instruction: Cluster operational taxonomic units (OTUs) and determine the taxonomy of each 16S rRNA gene sequence.

substeps.instruction: Cluster OTUs with a 97% similarity cutoff using UPARSE (version 7.1) with the 'greedy' algorithm for simultaneous chimera filtering and clustering.
Analyze taxonomy using the RDP Classifier algorithm against the Silva (SSU123) 16S rRNA database with a confidence threshold of 70%.
